why: FightSimulation stores range_owner/range_event only on current fight_state (lines 1114-1116) and appends the resolved event without copying either field (lines 438-445). Exact per-round/bout owner tallies cannot be derived after the fight. C23 forbids touching FightSimulation.gd; need scope widened to stamp range_owner/range_event on each logged exchange, or contract amended to allow empty owner aggregates.
